official.deadline_note: Central deadline of the 2026/2027 Stipendium Hungaricum round. Each sending partner (embassy, ministry or council) sets its own, often earlier, deadline and requirements. BME's separate fee-paying application window for programmes starting February 2027 is 15 October - 15 November 2026.
official.status_note: The 2026/2027 Stipendium Hungaricum application period is over: the deadline was 15 January 2026 at 2 p.m. CET, applications are not accepted after the deadline, and results were announced by the end of June 2026. As of the verification date the programme site had not yet published the next (2027/2028) call.
official.tuition_coverage_note: BME publishes 'no tuition fee' for the scholarship; the programme publishes 'Tuition-free education - exemption from the payment of tuition fee' for the duration of the studies.
official.funding_period: per month, 12 months per year until completion
benefits: No tuition fee - exemption from the payment of tuition fee for the whole study period

Monthly stipend of HUF 43,700 (cca EUR 110) for non-degree, bachelor's, master's, one-tier master's and postgraduate specialist training courses, as a contribution to living expenses, for 12 months a year until completion of studies
Doctoral level: HUF 140,000 per month in the first phase of education (4 semesters) and HUF 180,000 per month in the second phase (4 semesters), for 12 months a year until completion of studies
Free dormitory place or a contribution of HUF 40,000 per month to accommodation costs for the whole scholarship period
Health care services according to the relevant Hungarian legislation plus supplementary medical insurance for up to HUF 65,000 a year per person

Doctoral scholarship holders also receive a one-off grant of HUF 400,000; students awarded the excellence award on the host institution's proposal receive an increased scholarship of HUF 140,000 for one month in the awarded semester
eligibility: The Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship is a programme for foreign students, founded by the Hungarian Government in 2013 and managed by the Tempus Public Foundation
Available only to applicants from sending partners with a valid educational cooperation programme with Hungary
Applicants must be nominated by their sending partner; only nominated applicants can proceed with their applications
Offered at 30 Hungarian higher education institutions - BME is one of the host institutions - across more than 900 study programmes in foreign languages
Doctoral applicants may need to find a supervisor, depending on the requirements of the chosen Doctoral School
requirements: Application submitted through the Stipendium Hungaricum online application system; only two programme choices are allowed
The application must also be submitted to the responsible authority of the sending partner, which may set different deadlines and requirements
Applicants applying to BME programmes are required to complete an electronic e-admission exam or placement test
Exam scores must be a minimum of 56 out of 100 points for the application to be considered for the final list of scholarship awardees
BSc applicants found to have inadequate skills in the basic subjects (mathematics, physics or chemistry, and English) are directed to the one-year Preparatory Course before the BSc programmes
documents: Online application form in the Stipendium Hungaricum application system
Copy of passport, or a scanned national ID card plus a signed declaration stating that a valid passport will be uploaded before 1 August
High school or bachelor's/university certificate and transcripts of previous studies (level dependent)
Proof of English language proficiency - BME requires minimum level B2 for BSc/MSc programmes and accepts a Medium of Instruction Certificate
Medical certificate of satisfactory health condition on the programme's mandatory template, signed by a physician (required from awardees)
Statement of the supervisor for doctoral applicants where the proposed Doctoral School requires it (by 15 March 2026)
selection_criteria: Excellent academic track record and outstanding academic achievements
Nomination by the sending partner, which nominates the best applicants by the end of February
Entrance examination at the host institution between March and May, with a minimum score of 56 out of 100 points
Relevance of the chosen programmes to the field of study of the applicant
coverage: Tuition fees: exemption from the payment of tuition fee
Living expenses: monthly stipend of HUF 43,700 (doctoral: HUF 140,000 then HUF 180,000) as a contribution to living expenses
Accommodation: free dormitory place or a contribution of HUF 40,000 per month to accommodation costs
Health care: health care services according to the relevant Hungarian legislation and supplementary medical insurance up to HUF 65,000 a year per person
application_method: Register in the Stipendium Hungaricum online application system and upload the required documents by the deadline
Submit the application material also to the responsible sending partner
After nomination, sit the entrance examination set by the host institution (at BME, an electronic e-admission exam or placement test)
Tempus Public Foundation informs applicants of the official results by the end of June or the beginning of July
official.application_route: Apply online through the Stipendium Hungaricum (DreamApply) system and also to your country's sending partner; BME is the host institution and runs its own electronic e-admission entrance exam after nomination.
official.citizenship_residency: Foreign students only; eligibility rests on a bilateral education agreement between Hungary and the applicant's sending country, and the applicant must be nominated by that sending partner.
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the programme is for foreign/international students. It is open to applicants from any of the more than 100 sending partner countries with a valid educational cooperation programme with Hungary.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Applicants may apply only for study fields determined by the cooperation programme between Hungary and their country; only two programme choices are allowed and priorities cannot be edited after the deadline.
official.research_requirement: Doctoral applicants may need to find a supervisor and submit a statement of supervisor by 15 March 2026 where the proposed Doctoral School requires it; BME directs PhD applicants to the corresponding faculty.
official.duration: Full-degree programmes at bachelor's, master's, one-tier master's, non-degree and doctoral level; the stipend is paid for 12 months a year until completion of studies, with doctoral training in two four-semester phases.
official.description: BME presents Hungarian State Scholarships as covering tuition fees and providing help with living expenses for full training programmes, giving access to an unparalleled experience in graduate education. The Stipendium Hungaricum programme is the main route into BME for foreign students, offering tuition-free education, a monthly stipend, an accommodation contribution and medical insurance, managed by the Tempus Public Foundation.
official.program_type: Hungarian State scholarship for full-degree study at a Hungarian host institution (BME)
official.english_requirement: BME requires proof of English at minimum B2 level for BSc and MSc programmes: IELTS/IELTS Online min. 5.5, Cambridge B2 First (FCE) min. 160, TOEFL iBT min. 72, Trinity ISE II, TOEIC Listening 400 / Reading 385 / Speaking 160 / Writing 150, Pearson Academic (PTE) min. 50 or Duolingo English Test min. 100 - or a Medium of Instruction Certificate. Preparatory programmes require B1 (IELTS min. 4.5, Duolingo min. 60, TOEFL iBT min. 42). Individual units may set higher minimum language test scores.

not_confirmed: Award amounts for BME's outbound mobility schemes (Erasmus+, CEEPUS, ATHENS, Makovecz, Suzuki, Pan-European Seal, summer/winter schools) - BME's own pages list programme, destination, duration, eligible students and application months but publish no stipend figures
Exact deadlines for those outbound schemes beyond the application months listed on BME's site (Erasmus+ study mobility: February and August; CEEPUS: October and June; Suzuki: September)

Award values for the Hungarian Diaspora Scholarship, Scholarship for Christian Young People and Students at Risk programmes as presented on BME's pages, which link out to the awarding bodies without quoting figures
Deadline for the next (2027/2028) Stipendium Hungaricum round, which had not been published at the verification date
Any travel or installation allowance - no such provision is published
verification.notes: Amounts, provisions and coverage verified on BME's own scholarship page and cross-checked against the programme's About page and current Operational Regulations; BME confirmed as a Stipendium Hungaricum host institution with an institutional coordinator on the programme's Study Finder; deadline and cycle taken from the programme's Apply page and the 2026/2027 call announcement; documents, English requirements and BME's application window taken from xplore.bme.hu.

applicant_utility.summary: The only funding amounts BME publishes for incoming international students are the Hungarian state Stipendium Hungaricum package at BME: tuition waived, HUF 43,700 a month at bachelor's and master's level (140,000 then 180,000 at doctoral level), a dormitory place or HUF 40,000 monthly housing allowance, and a HUF 65,000 yearly health contribution. You cannot apply for this through BME directly - you register in the Stipendium Hungaricum system, also file with your sending partner, and only two programme choices are permitted. The round runs once a year against a hard mid-January deadline, so your sending partner's own earlier cut-off is the date that really decides your file. BME's other scholarships page is for outgoing BME students only and publishes no figures at all.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Applicants from Stipendium Hungaricum partner countries who want an English-taught engineering, IT, natural-science or economics degree in Budapest and can live on a modest stipend.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm first that your country is a Stipendium Hungaricum sending partner and that your study field appears on its list - without that there is nothing to apply for
Contact your sending partner (embassy, ministry or council) for its own deadline and paperwork, which is usually weeks before the central deadline
Cross-check BME's programme list against the eligible-programmes annex for your country, then order your two choices carefully because priorities cannot be edited after submission
Hold an English certificate at or above BME's minimum B2 for BSc/MSc, or a Medium of Instruction Certificate as an accepted alternative
Practise on BME's published e-admission sample tests, because entrance exam results must reach 56 out of 100 to stay in contention
Budget for the gap between the HUF 40,000 housing allowance and actual Budapest rents before accepting an offer
common_rejection_risks: Coming from a country without a valid educational cooperation programme with Hungary, which makes the scholarship unavailable
Missing your sending partner's nomination, since only nominated applicants move forward to the universities
Scoring below 56 out of 100 in the entrance examination, which takes the application off the final awardee list
Selecting programmes that are not on the eligible list for your country or your study field
Applying straight to BME instead of through the Stipendium Hungaricum system, which the programme explicitly says is not a valid route
Being an already-enrolled self-financed student at a Hungarian institution applying for the same study level without a host-university recommendation and a credit index above the programme average
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Flights and initial settling-in costs, residence-permit and visa fees, and the shortfall between the HUF 40,000 monthly accommodation contribution and real Budapest rents. The programme states plainly that its provisions are only a contribution to living expenses and that students must add their own financial resources to cover all living costs in Hungary.
document_audit: You can start and submit without a passport - upload a national ID scan plus a signed declaration - but a valid passport has to be on file before 1 August
The medical certificate must use the programme's own mandatory template and be issued and signed by a physician; ad hoc doctor's letters are not the document asked for
Language certificates must meet BME's stated minimums (B2 for BSc/MSc, B1 for preparatory programmes); the accepted alternative is a Medium of Instruction Certificate, not a self-declared level

Do not pay BME's EUR 150 application fee on a Stipendium Hungaricum file - registration and participation in the admission examinations are free of charge under the programme, and that fee belongs to the fee-paying e-admission route
MSc and transfer applications need transcripts of previous studies, and MSc additionally needs two recommendation letters and a CV
alerts: The 2026/2027 round closed on 15 January 2026 at 2 p.m. CET; nothing is accepted after the deadline and a miss costs a full year
Sending partners often close their own submissions earlier than the central deadline, so check their calendar before you start uploading
Host institution, study programme and language of study can be changed only once per study level, only at the end of a semester and only within one year of starting
Full-time bachelor and master students must complete two semesters of Hungarian as a foreign language; not attending means no monthly stipend and failing the exam cuts it to HUF 30,000 per month
Being outside Hungary for more than 30 consecutive days suspends the living and housing allowances until you return

Some institutional dates printed on BME's scholarship page (the transfer-window examples for 2022 and 2023) are out of date, so confirm current BME dates with the BME Stipendium Hungaricum coordinator at international@bme.hu
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register and upload documents in the Stipendium Hungaricum online system and file the same material with your sending partner by the deadline; Tempus Public Foundation forwards nominated applications to BME by the end of February, BME then contacts you directly to arrange the e-admission entrance exam between March and May, and Tempus announces official results by the end of June or start of July.
